value: Shelah's ded bound on the traces of a family of finite VC dimension. On an infinite ground set a family of finite VC dimension traces at most ded #A sets, and by mk_image_inter_range_cut_eq_ded the bound is attained. The infiniteness of A is not decorative: see exists_finite_ground_hasVCDimLE_not_mk_image_inter_le_ded.

∀ {α : Type u} {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {A : Set α} {d : ℕ},
  HasVCDimLE d 𝒜 → A.Infinite → Cardinal.mk ↑((fun x => A ∩ x) '' 𝒜) ≤ ded (Cardinal.mk ↑A)
